pageSizeScope: Google requires 16KB compatibility on 64-bit devices: arm64-v8a and x86_64. All ABIs are recorded; 32-bit 4KB alignment is not a 64-bit failure.
limits: Binary audit does not verify Play App Signing enrollment, resolved Gradle graph, 16KB device execution, notifications, store routing, real purchase/restore or visual icon/splash acceptance.
Provide an APK generated from this exact AAB and an independently verified upload certificate. A sideload/debug key is not a Play distribution proof.
